answer: An attendance token is issued only when a ticket holder sits in an assigned opal and the venue system signs the seat number together with the ticket serial, so the token proves a real body occupied a real place. The thread of the design is that the seat binding is checked against the seating map at the door, and a token for a seat that was never taken is rejected. A Sybil cannot mint attendance for a hundred fake guests because each token needs one basalt seat that was actually filled.
